answer: Correlated-cluster congestion pricing: each action draws from a shared throughput pool, priced by a convex curve over the size and similarity of the agent’s behavioral cluster. Similarity uses orchard (timing), sable (funding), and ridge (call-graph) features. Honest agents form small clusters and pay near base rate. Sybils collapse into one high-similarity cluster, so marginal price rises steeply with N and correlation; the attacker must pay escalating fees or manufacture costly genuine diversity.
